baseline_source.text: הִרְבִּ֣יתָ הַ/גּ֔וֹי לא הִגְדַּ֣לְתָּ הַ/שִּׂמְחָ֑ה שָׂמְח֤וּ לְ/פָנֶ֨י/ךָ֙ כְּ/שִׂמְחַ֣ת בַּ/קָּצִ֔יר כַּ/אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָגִ֖ילוּ בְּ/חַלְּקָ֥/ם שָׁלָֽל׃

baseline_english: You have multiplied the nation[a]; you have not increased the joy. They rejoice before you as with the joy at harvest[b], as men exult when they divide spoil.

baseline_second_note.text: Or 'they rejoice before you like the joy of harvest, like people rejoicing when they divide plunder.'
